When we started Purity Beans, the easiest path in the Indian instant coffee market was to follow the industry standard: use vague terms, hide the exact composition, and let people guess what they were drinking in their morning mug. But running a transparent direct-to-consumer brand means facing uncomfortable questions about every single jar we ship.

We spent months testing formulations until we settled on Ultra Blend as a smooth 70% coffee and 30% chicory milk coffee designed specifically for everyday milk drinkers who want consistency without hidden surprises. Putting exact percentages on the label changed everything. Customers stopped guessing and started reading.

Building an honest coffee brand in India taught us one clear lesson: when you stop hiding your ingredient ratios, consumers reward you with long-term trust. Transparency is not a marketing tactic; it is the baseline requirement for modern grocery brands.

blog_post.introduction: In Mumbai and Bengaluru the usual cup is milk coffee, so the chicory line changes the taste. Purity Beans lists Ultra Blend as 70% coffee and 30% chicory, and the prices below are in ₹ on p3online.in.
blog_post.body:
## What does freeze-dried instant coffee mean for an Indian kitchen?

When you open a jar of Purity Beans, you might notice the texture looks quite different from standard powders. Instead of fine dust, you get delicate, crystal-like granules. That is because of a gentle dehydration process that locks in the natural oils and aroma of the beans without subjecting them to harsh heat. For an Indian kitchen, this means your morning cup holds onto that deep, roasted flavor much longer, tasting remarkably close to a pour-over even when you are rushing out the door. Think about how we store our pantry staples to keep them fresh—coffee deserves that same respect. A quick stir into hot milk or water yields a clean, bold cup every single time. It is a simple upgrade for anyone who wants a cafe-style experience at home without the fuss or the inflated price tag.

### A plain definition

Whatever brought you here, the label settles it. Ultra Blend is 70% coffee and 30% chicory. The other single jars on this page are 0% chicory.

## How do you read the chicory line on the jar?
